keyword: ftc v invitation homes refund administrator
claims: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is mailing over 444,000 checks totaling more than $47.2 million to Invitation Homes renters.
The mailing is due to a settlement over hidden fees and deceptive rental practices between January 2021 and September 2024.
Rust Consulting is the refund administrator.
Renters who paid at least $45 in covered, undisclosed fees (e.g., smart home, utility management) or unfair move-out charges are eligible.
Checks must be cashed within 90 days of receipt.
Eligible consumers will receive an average payment of $106.
Anyone who already received a direct refund or credit from Invitation Homes for these charges is not eligible.
The FTC accused Invitation Homes of advertising misleadingly low lease prices.
The FTC accused Invitation Homes of failing to disclose mandatory fees.
The FTC accused Invitation Homes of unfairly withholding security deposits for normal wear-and-tear.
